valuable to ship over here and I
can’t leave this LAB to get it...

POKéMON {PLAYER}!

BALL for me.

your POKéMON.

stamped to be able to travel to the
ORANGE ISLANDS.

PROF.OAK stamps the back of
{PLAYER}’s SS.TICKET!
The boat leaves from VERMILION CITY
only.
The TRAINERS over in the ORANGE
ISLANDS are quite powerful so you
better watch your step!
Good luck!
